message.content: {"caption":"Three grouped bar charts comparing agent performance across model transfers and programming-task transfers.","description":"The target is a three-panel grouped bar chart. Each panel’s vertical axis is success rate (%) and starts at zero. All bar values are printed above the bars. In the left panel, “Model Transfer on SWE-bench,” the y-axis runs to 60%. Categories are o3-mini, Claude 3.5 Sonnet (New), and Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Gray denotes Initial Agent, light blue Best Agent transfer to other FMs, and blue Best Agent from DGM. For o3-mini, Initial Agent is 23.0% and Best Agent transfer to other FMs is 33.0%. For Claude 3.5 Sonnet (New), Initial Agent is 20.0% and Best Agent from DGM is 50.0%. For Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Initial Agent is 19.0% and Best Agent transfer to other FMs is 59.0%. In the middle panel, “Model Transfer on Polyglot,” the y-axis runs to 40% and the model categories are the same. For o3-mini, Initial Agent is 14.2% and Best Agent from DGM is 30.7%. For Claude 3.5 Sonnet (New), Initial Agent is 32.0% and Best Agent transfer to other FMs is 33.3%. For Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Initial Agent is 35.6% and Best Agent transfer to other FMs is 36.8%. In both model-transfer panels, the DGM-discovered or transferred agent result shown is higher than the corresponding Initial Agent result. In the right panel, “Task Transfer on Polyglot,” the y-axis runs to 40% and the categories are python task and non-python task. Gray denotes Initial Agent, green Aider, purple DGM search on all language, and orange DGM search only on python. For python task, the values are respectively 8.8%, 11.8%, 17.6%, and 20.6%; for non-python task they are 15.2%, 17.3%, 33.0%, and 30.8%. The non-python task bars are higher than the python-task bars for Initial Agent, Aider, and DGM search on all language, while DGM search only on python is lower on non-python tasks than on python tasks.
